plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Ranked Fitness reads from Apple Health only to show you your own numbers and to offer to tick off a daily task you have linked to them. It reads: steps, active energy and workouts (today's activity, and a workout can vouch for a workout task); logged food energy (to offer to mark your diet task done); your most recent weight (to pre-fill the weekly check-in); sleep (how long you slept and when you woke, for sleep and wake-up tasks and a last-night summary); water (for a water task); mindful minutes (for a meditation task); and resting heart rate, heart rate variability and respiratory rate (shown as last night's value beside a 7-day average). Nothing is written to Health. Everything read stays on this phone: it is never uploaded, never stored on our servers, and never visible to your squad. Only the tasks you confirm as done are shared, never the Health data behind them.
